Get ready to dance all night with spooky Bollywood vibes and killer beats at this epic Halloween bash!

About this Event

🎃 BOLLYWOOD HALLOWEEN | EDEN NYC 🎃
A little spooky. A little filmy. A whole lot of dancing.
Bollywood Nights NYC and Brown New York invite you to celebrate Halloween at EDEN on Friday, October 23, 2026. Bring your crew, dress to impress, and get ready for a night of Bollywood beats with DEEP & DEV behind the decks.
From iconic sing-along moments to dance-floor favorites, come ready to celebrate with fellow Bollywood lovers in the heart of Manhattan.
EVENT DETAILS
📅 Friday, October 23, 2026
📍 EDEN — 20 West 36th Street, New York, NY 10018
🎧 Sounds by DEEP & DEV
👻 Halloween costumes encouraged
For Table Reservation / More Info. Call Kish (848) 247 -8082 
Whether your look is spooky, glamorous, or inspired by your favorite Bollywood character, bring the energy and make the night your own.
Book your tickets, gather your friends, and join us for Bollywood Halloween at EDEN!
